reading.body:
Southwest Cyberport publishes no dedicated data center facility address, no power capacity, and no square footage. The only physical address on the operator's site is a business office in Albuquerque. The company describes itself as offering colocated servers as a service, which suggests customer equipment may sit at a separate, unpublished facility rather than at the published office address. Without a confirmed facility location or published specifications, this entry cannot be assessed for relevance to AI infrastructure scaling.

New Mexico has 14 mapped data center facilities in OpenStreetMap, but none of them publish power capacity figures. Southwest Cyberport ranks first among New Mexico facilities by published megawatts only because the state publishes zero megawatts across all mapped sites. This ranking is empty. The entire state contributes no documented compute capacity to national AI infrastructure visibility.

This entry is flagged for human review. It may represent a real colocation operator, a real facility under a different address, or a misattribution. Until the operator publishes a facility address with power specifications, or a researcher confirms the actual location and capacity, this campus cannot be read as a meaningful data point for AI infrastructure assessment.
